copy.title: Custom Sugar Flower Package Estimator
copy.intro: Let's find out if we're a good fit to work together! Tell me about your dream cake to estimate the pricing. After you reach out, I'll walk you through a detailed design proposal and final quote.
copy.labelSize: Your Cake Size (it's okay to estimate if it's not finalized yet)
copy.estimateEmpty: Choose your cake size and style to see your estimate.
copy.includeCustom: Your design will be fully customized and color-matched to your palette
copy.includeShipping: Delivered to you with our Delicate-but-Durable Shipping Promise
copy.othersHeading: Other packages I recommend for a {size} cake
copy.noteFinal: Your final quote will be based on the complexity and details for your unique cake.
copy.noteRetainer: Since we are a small, artist-owned boutique, we can only book a limited number of custom designs each year. Since we are still available for your date, you can hold your date with a $150 retainer that goes toward your final invoice.
copy.noteRush: Just a head's up! Your date is less than {rushWeeks} weeks away. A rush fee may apply.
copy.noteShort: Oh dear! Custom designs need at least {minWeeks} weeks’ notice. We may be booked already, but please reach out, and we'll see what we can do!
copy.shopBudget: For budgets under $350, my ready-to-ship sugar flower collection is the best fit. Inventory is limited, so be sure to grab your favorites!
copy.shopDate: Oh no! Your event is less than 3 weeks away, which is too soon for a custom design. But don't worry! My ready-to-ship Sugar Flower collection was made for exactly this situation!
copy.inquiryAnyway: Still looking for something custom? Let us know what you're looking for!
copy.barEmpty: Your personalized package recommendation is calculating...
copy.embedNote: Every design is color-matched to your personalized palette. Custom designs need at least {minWeeks} weeks’ notice; dates under {rushWeeks} weeks out may include a rush fee. Your final quote is based on your exact design.
copy.detailsIntro: After you’ve submitted your inquiry, I’ll check my calendar for availability and send you a more detailed questionnaire about your cake design via email.
copy.labelReferral: How did you find out about Sugar Flowers by Kelsie Cakes?
copy.labelVision: Anything else you’d like to share about your design? We’ll go over all the details together, but I’d love to hear what you’re envisioning!
copy.labelPhotos: Do you have any inspiration photos you’d like to share?
copy.allergenText: Sugar Flowers contain egg whites and are not created in an allergen-free facility. They may contain inedible material, such as floral wire, and are not for consumption.
copy.missing: Oops! Please fill in the highlighted fields.
copy.sendError: Oh dear! Something went wrong sending your inquiry. Please try again, or email hello@sugarflowersonline.com.
copy.thanksHeading: Thank you so much for your inquiry!
copy.thanksText: Please check your email to make sure you received the confirmation email. I’m so excited to work with you! I’ve verify availability and send you a more detailed questionnaire about your cake design via email. I look forward to meeting with you!
copy.labelPalette: What’s your color palette for this floral arrangement?
copy.cardSummary: Your custom sugar flower design price estimate
